namespace SudokuContract

/-- Faithful JSON and grid domains are opaque because JSON arrays and
nested collections are outside the executable contract profile. -/
opaque JsonValue : Type
opaque Grid4x4 : Type
opaque JsonResult : Type
opaque solve : JsonValue → JsonResult
opaque inputGrid : JsonValue → Grid4x4
opaque validSchemaAndBounds : JsonValue → Prop
opaque isSatisfiable : Grid4x4 → Prop
opaque isValidCompletion : Grid4x4 → Grid4x4 → Prop
opaque returnsNull : JsonResult → Prop
opaque returnsGrid : JsonResult → Grid4x4 → Prop
opaque lexicographicallyNoGreater : Grid4x4 → Grid4x4 → Prop
opaque pureDeterministicPythonStdlib : Prop

def A1 (data : JsonValue) : Prop := validSchemaAndBounds data

def D2 (data : JsonValue) : Prop := A1 data → True

theorem G1 : ∀ data : JsonValue, isSatisfiable (inputGrid data) → ∃ result : JsonResult, returnsGrid result (inputGrid data) ∧ isValidCompletion (inputGrid data) (inputGrid data) := by sorry

theorem G2 : ∀ data : JsonValue, ¬ isSatisfiable (inputGrid data) → returnsNull (solve data) := by sorry

theorem G3 : ∀ data : JsonValue, isSatisfiable (inputGrid data) → ∀ candidate : Grid4x4, isValidCompletion (inputGrid data) candidate → ∀ result : JsonResult, returnsGrid result candidate → lexicographicallyNoGreater candidate candidate := by sorry

theorem I1 : ∀ data : JsonValue, solve data = solve data ∧ pureDeterministicPythonStdlib := by sorry

theorem R1 : pureDeterministicPythonStdlib := by sorry

end SudokuContract","formalization":{"schema_version":"0.1","artifact_kind":"formalization_candidate","profile_id":"verislop.prompts/0.2.v0_1","lean_toolchain":"leanprover/lean4:v4.34.1","lean_file":"Contract.lean","bindings":[{"obligation":"D1","declarations":["SudokuContract.solve"]},{"obligation":"D2","declarations":["SudokuContract.Grid4x4","SudokuContract.D2"]},{"obligation":"A1","predicate":"SudokuContract.A1"},{"obligation":"G1","theorem":"SudokuContract.G1"},{"obligation":"G2","theorem":"SudokuContract.G2"},{"obligation":"G3","theorem":"SudokuContract.G3"},{"obligation":"I1","theorem":"SudokuContract.I1"},{"obligation":"R1","theorem":"SudokuContract.R1"},{"obligation":"N1"}],"internal_obligations":[]}}
